questions.stem: Marigoldspring wants faster, lower-cost desk lamps growth by encouraging existing customers to refer friends. Which approach fits?

options.text: A large television advertising campaign
options.misconception: Costly and does not leverage existing customers

options.text: Raising product prices to fund expansion
options.misconception: May reduce demand rather than drive growth

options.text: Opening expensive physical showrooms in many cities
options.misconception: High cost and slow to scale

options.text: A referral program that rewards customers for bringing in new buyers

questions.explanation: Referral programs use current customers to acquire new ones, often at low cost and with higher trust. Mass advertising and new showrooms are expensive, and raising prices can suppress the demand needed for growth.
questions.hint: Look for growth driven by existing customers at low cost.
